source.name: Zoho to Dynamics 365 Business Central with BURQ iPaaS

mapping.summary: iPaaS connector syncing Zoho CRM accounts, products, orders and invoices with Business Central
claims: Zoho accounts create BC customers, with two-way contact and address sync
BC items publish to Zoho as products with tiered prices in price books
Zoho sales orders become BC sales orders with status sent back
BC invoices and payment status sync back to Zoho
Zoho leads convert to BC prospects
Auto-retry, dead-letter queues and error alerts
Visual field mapping without a developer
One-time installation fee plus annual renewal, no per-transaction fees
